{{Quote|The Imperial Star Destroyer ''Desolator'' was lost in space today, due to collision with the rogue star G-138. The collision was apparently a result of a hyperdrive malfunction. All hands were lost, including Admiral Grendreef of the Imperial Navy.|[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], reading an [[Imperial News Bureau]] bulletin|<ref name="TIC" />}}
'''G-138''' was a rogue [[Star/Legends|star]] that consumed the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s reprogrammed the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]].

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that G-138 was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a wandering astronomical object.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
